# Assumption of Moses Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Corrupt Rulers of the Last Days

---

**7:1** But after their ruin — after the time of this punishment — there will arise from among them men who will be deceitful in times of peace.

**7:2** They will be self-promoters, hypocrites in all their conduct, lovers of banquets at every hour of the day, gluttons, devourers.

**7:3** They will eat and drink things that belong to those who are poor and afflicted.

**7:4** They will say: we have set tables fit for kings.

**7:5** Their hands and minds will deal with unclean things, and their mouths will speak great things.

**7:6** They will say furthermore: do not touch me, lest you defile me in the position I occupy.

**7:7** And they will be deceitful men, hating and reproaching one another.

**7:8** Loving luxury, accepting bribes, with no justice in their ways.

**7:9** They will devour widows and the houses of gentle men and will say: we are just.

**7:10** But in reality they will destroy our land, devouring the goods of the upright with plunder and with wicked deceit.

**7:11** They will have no more wisdom than ordinary men and they will have the reputation of men of learning.

**7:12** They will be puffed up with pride and will say: I am a lord, sitting on a throne, and my honor is first and foremost.
